entries.title: Xbox 360 prompts · Elden Ring style
entries.author: Dommo (goomab); download published by Jgamrot
entries.summary: Changes the in-game button artwork to Xbox prompts. Data-only archive inspected; gameplay on Thor has not been tested. Source: Dommo’s Xbox (and switch) UI mod, version 0.3.2. Button artwork does not remap physical controls.

entries.title: Xbox and Switch UI · other variants
entries.author: Dommo (goomab)
entries.summary: Choose other controller artwork variants on the author’s page. Website login/download may be required. Import the downloaded archive here. Thor gameplay compatibility is unverified.

entries.title: More Options At Lamps (MOAL)
entries.author: CocaGeladinhaHmm
entries.summary: Adds extra lamp menu actions. Current 2.x targets a PC port and some features need another mod/patch; Android compatibility is unverified. Read the author’s requirements before downloading. APK/executable or eboot replacements cannot be imported here.

entries.title: Reduced Physics
entries.author: Kyoski
entries.summary: Offers cloth-physics variants. Made as an emulator workaround; improvement on the native Android port is unverified. Check the author’s warnings and choose a variant deliberately.

entries.title: BBReborne · visual overhaul
entries.author: See Nexus page
entries.summary: Large texture, lighting and material overhaul built for the shadPS4 PC build of Bloodborne. It targets that desktop pipeline and ships multi-gigabyte packs, so it is not made for the native Android port and compatibility on Thor is unverified and likely limited — listed for awareness. Whole-build or executable downloads cannot be imported here.
